name: Kinetic Jaunt
body:
School transmutation; Level alchemist 2, bard 2, inquisitor 2, magus 2, psychic 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, summoner/unchained summoner 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action
Components S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target self
Duration 1 round/level

You charge your movements with energy and force giving you speed and agility. You gain the following benefits:

+10 enhancement bonus to your base speed
+5 enhancement bonus to any other movement speed you posses
A bonus on Acrobatics checks equal to 1/2 your caster level.
Moving through an enemy’s space does not have a higher Acrobatics DC than moving through a threatened space.
Once per round, you ignore the first threatened square of movement when determining if you trigger an attack of opportunity or need to roll Acrobatics.
